units.source_text: 云居雁生得娇小玲珑，天真烂漫。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was small and delicate, innocent and artless.

units.source_text: 弹筝时鬓发长垂，头面楚楚，模样异常高雅优美。

en.t: When she played the koto, the hair at her temples hung long, her face was charmingly neat, and her whole appearance was exceptionally graceful and beautiful.

units.source_text: 看见父亲目不转睛地注视她，难为情起来，把头略略转向一旁，那侧影又很美丽。

en.t: Seeing her father gazing fixedly at her, she grew embarrassed and turned her head slightly aside, and even her profile was beautiful.

units.source_text: 左手按弦的姿态非常雅观，竟像一个玩偶。

en.t: The way her left hand pressed the strings was so elegant that she looked almost like a doll.

units.source_text: 祖母看了也觉得无限可爱。

en.t: Her grandmother, watching her, also found her endlessly adorable.

units.source_text: 云居雁戏耍似地弹了一会，就把筝推开了。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari played for a while as if she were only amusing herself, then pushed the koto away.

units.source_text: 内大臣便取过和琴来，用他那纯熟而随意不拘的手法，弹出一个时髦的短调，非常动人。

en.t: The Inner Minister then took up the wagon and, with his practiced and easygoing touch, played a fashionable short melody that was deeply moving.

units.source_text: 庭前木叶尽行散落。

en.t: All the leaves before the garden had fallen and lay scattered.

units.source_text: 年老的侍女们感动得流下泪来，都挤集在各处帷屏背后倾听。

en.t: The elderly serving women were moved to tears and crowded behind the screens in various places to listen.

units.source_text: 内大臣便朗诵“风之力盖寡……”之词。

en.t: The Inner Minister then recited the words, The strength of the wind is slight...

units.source_text: 接着说道：“并非琴音之故，只因这暮景异常凄凉动人耳。

en.t: He went on to say, It is not because of the sound of the koto, but only because this evening scene is so unusually lonely and moving.

units.source_text: 请太君再弹一曲吧。”

en.t: Please, my lady, play one more piece.

units.source_text: 太君弹时，内大臣唱着《秋风乐》之歌，与她相和，其歌声非常优美。

en.t: When the lady played, the Inner Minister sang the song Autumn Wind Music in harmony with her, and his voice was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 太君对人人都爱，觉得这儿子内大臣也很可喜。

en.t: The lady loved everyone, and she also found this son of hers, the Inner Minister, very pleasing.

units.source_text: 这时夕雾也来了，又添了乐趣。

en.t: Just then Yugiri also arrived, adding still more enjoyment.

units.source_text: 内大臣便命张起帷屏来，把云居雁隔开，叫夕雾坐在这边，对他说道：“好久不见你了。

en.t: The Inner Minister ordered screens to be set up to separate Kumoi no Kari, had Yugiri sit on this side, and said to him, I have not seen you for a long time.

units.source_text: 何必如此埋头读书呢？

en.t: Why must you bury yourself in study like this?

units.source_text: 你父亲太政大臣也知道，学问过多，反而乏味。

en.t: Your father, the Chancellor, knows too that too much learning can become tedious instead.

units.source_text: 却教你如此钻研学问，究竟为了何事呢？

en.t: Yet he has you devote yourself to study so intensely; what can it really be for?

units.source_text: 镇日笼闭一室，你也太苦了。”

en.t: Shut up in one room all day, you must be suffering far too much.

units.source_text: 又说：“有时也该做些学问以外之事。

en.t: He also said, Sometimes you should do things beyond your studies.

units.source_text: 譬如吹笛，也是古代传下来的韵事。”

en.t: Playing the flute, for example, is also an elegant art handed down from ancient times.

units.source_text: 便拿一支笛给他吹奏。

en.t: He then handed him a flute and had him play it.

units.source_text: 夕雾吹得生趣洋溢，非常悦耳。

en.t: Yugiri played with lively charm, and the sound was very pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 内大臣暂时停止弹琴，轻轻地替他按拍，自己唱起“满身染上萩花斑”的催马乐。

en.t: The Inner Minister stopped playing for a while, lightly kept time for him, and himself began to sing the saibara song My whole body is dyed with bush clover patterns.

units.source_text: 唱毕言道：“太政大臣也喜欢音乐，政务烦忙之时也常常借以消遣呢。

en.t: When he had finished singing, he said, The Chancellor also loves music, and even when busy with affairs of state he often uses it for diversion.

units.source_text: 实在，生在这乏味的世间，应该做些喜爱之事，欢度岁月才是。”

en.t: Indeed, born into this dreary world, one ought to do the things one loves and pass the years joyfully.

units.source_text: 便命斟过酒来畅饮。

en.t: He then ordered wine to be poured and drank freely.

units.source_text: 这期间天色渐黑，室内点起灯来。

en.t: Meanwhile the sky gradually darkened, and lamps were lit indoors.

units.source_text: 大家同吃饭菜与果物。

en.t: Everyone ate rice, dishes, and fruit together.

units.source_text: 不久内大臣命云居雁回那边房间里去了。

en.t: Before long the Inner Minister ordered Kumoi no Kari to return to the room on the other side.

units.source_text: 内大臣强欲教两人疏远，现在有了入宫的打算，连云居雁的琴音也不给夕雾听到，更加严厉地隔绝他们了。

en.t: The Inner Minister was determined to force the two apart, and now that he had plans for her to enter court service, he would not even let Yugiri hear Kumoi no Kari's koto, separating them even more strictly.

units.source_text: 太君身边的几个老年侍女悄悄地议论道：“如此下去，只怕他们之间发生不幸之事呢！”

en.t: Several elderly serving women beside the lady whispered among themselves, If this goes on, something unfortunate may happen between them.
